major_concerns: Design relies on human "blinded operator-rubric scorers" whereas the capability manifest disallows human scientific labour — threatens compliance and reproducibility.
Operator-rubric subjectivity and potential low inter-rater reliability reduce internal validity and reproducibility.
Curated/synthetic task set may not adequately represent production multi-vendor diversity (external validity risk).
Validator scope (syntax + Batfish-style checks) may miss semantic/intent mismatches, creating a correctness–congruence gap not fully addressed.
Single LLM family limits generality; claims may not generalize across models or vendors.
required_design_repairs: Remove dependence on human operator scoring or explicitly justify and document approved simulated/automated evaluators that obey the autonomy constraints (e.g., deterministic LLM-based evaluators with calibration and cross-checking).
Provide a detailed, privacy-safe public dataset construction plan (sources, anonymization, augmentation steps) and publish dataset + seed split for reproducibility.
Specify validator capabilities and failure modes; include explicit tests showing which semantic mismatches are undetectable and how repairs handle them.
Either include at least one additional, clearly named model family or justify single-family choice and scope claims accordingly.
Preregister inter-rater/agreement simulation procedure and automated fallback policies for ambiguous cases.

major_concerns: Operator-workload proxy is underspecified and may not validly represent real operator cognitive or temporal cost.
Lab latency measures risk being unrepresentative of production concurrency and scheduling; external validity concern.
Seeding strategy for failures may bias measured false-negative rates if not realistic.
Integration complexity between LLM outputs and verifier tiers is a source of measurement bias if not rigorously instrumented.
required_design_repairs: Define and validate an operator-workload metric that requires no human annotation (e.g., deterministic reviewer-time estimator based on validator output characteristics) or justify use of simulated operators consistent with autonomy constraints.
Provide detailed latency-measurement protocol that includes variance estimation under simulated concurrency and standardized hardware/network conditions.
Specify realistic failure-seeding methodology (empirically grounded or drawn from public incident corpora) and publish seeding scripts and seeds.
Include end-to-end integration tests and publish containerized verifier implementations and harness to ensure others can reproduce timing and detection results.

major_concerns: Relies on human blinded operator evaluators (conflicts with no-human-labour constraint).
Formalizing high-level intent for semantic checks is underspecified and may require significant manual effort, threatening reproducibility and feasibility under autonomy constraints.
Between-tasks balanced design reduces within-task causal control; causal attribution to validators vs task heterogeneity may be weak.
Sample size/power for complex tasks may be insufficient; power analysis not shown.
required_design_repairs: Replace human evaluators with an autonomously reproducible evaluation pipeline (e.g., formalized intent specs derived automatically from public intent templates, LLM-based adjudicators with calibration, or deterministic oracle checks).
Provide a precise method to generate formalized high-level intent automatically from dataset metadata or operator-like scripts; include validation of that method.

Change to a paired within-task design if feasible to strengthen causal claims or justify and preregister how between-task balancing will control confounding; include power analysis with preregistered sample-size justification.
Publish automated scoring code, data, seeds, and rubric as part of the artifact bundle to support reproducibility.

major_concerns: Public corpus curation is constrained by privacy/vendor sensitivity; representativeness may suffer if only limited public artifacts are usable.
Taxonomy risks oversimplifying complex verifier behaviors and may misclassify hybrid verifier capabilities without clear attribute definitions.
Injection strategy for benchmark faults must avoid bias toward easily detectable failures; design is underspecified.
Community adoption depends on clear, containerized oracle implementations and straightforward reproduction instructions; current plan lacks explicit packaging details.
required_design_repairs: Limit corpus to provably public, non-sensitive sources and document anonymization steps; include provenance metadata for each item.
Define taxonomy axes precisely (machine-readable descriptors) and provide mapping rules and examples tying taxonomy attributes to verifier implementations.
Design and document an adversary-aware injection protocol that balances naturalistic and engineered failure modes; publish injection scripts and seeds.
Provide containerized exemplar oracle implementations (Docker) and a reproducibility checklist; include unit tests and a small end-to-end replication script in the release artifacts.
